pattern: Generated cards tend to fit the whole object inside the frame, upright, frontal and centred, with even margins and little crop. They also add supporting props or scenery that compete at thumbnail size, such as a moon, fence, trees or slab, or they leave thin subjects with low occupancy on a busy background. Real cards push one hero closer, turn it three-quarter or tilt it, and let edges crop it, so it holds a single clear mass.
